(tha)༄༅/ /tshe sgrub kyi cho ga sogs nyer mkho phan bde'i sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/sangs rgyas kun gyi rjes chags dngos/

tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// tshe sgrub kyi cho ga sogs nyer mkho phan bde'i sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rjes chags dngos// rgyal ba tshe 'dzin dbang po'i skur// ston mdzad de la rab dang bas// phyag 'tshal nas ni sgrub thabs bshad// skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba/ de'i steng gi oṃ gyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje dkar po/ g.yon dang po shel gyi phreng ba/ 'og ma gnyis yum la 'khyud tshul gyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na shel gyi bum pa bdud rtsi dkar pos gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum pad+ma kuṇ+ḍa lī dmar mo phyag dang po gnyis kyis byi ru'i bgrang phreng dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pas pad+ma rā ga'i bum pa bdud rtsi dmar pos gang ba 'dzin pa/ pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i spyi bor rnam snang dkar po/ mgrin par snang mtha' dmar po/ snying gar mi bskyod pa sngon po/ lte bar rin 'byung ser po/ gsang bar don grub ljang gu rnams phyag g.yas rang rtags dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa rang snang gi yum dang bcas par gyur/ mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' tshe dpag tu med pa yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su oṃ/ klad dkor gyi dbus su thig le dkar la 'tsher ba/ nyi zla ā li kā li'i skud pas bcings pa/ ba spu'i sgo thams cad rta mgrin phyag gnyis pa g.yas be con 'dzin cing g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa khro bo'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i go chas gtams pa/

ye shes pa bstim pa dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab spyi dang 'dra ba las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ de nas bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ tshe gzungs oṃ gnyis ma gang nus bzla'o// rjes mi dmigs par bsams la dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ a las byung ba'i ka pā la bcud dang bcas pa me rlung gi sbyar bas sbyangs/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs la bstim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes byin gyis brlab/ rang gi mdun du rgyal ba tshe dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a kā ro lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe yi bdag /rgyal ba kun gyis rtag tu dgongs gyur pa'i// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi skye shi gcod pa po// skye dgu rnams kyi skyabs gyur bcom ldan 'das// dad pas bdag ni rtag tu bstod phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/ bgegs dang 'chi las rnam grol ba'i// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho de// mkha' mnyam rnams dang lhan cig tu// myur du thob par mdzad du gsol// ces gsol ba gdab/ yig brgyas kha bskang*/ badz+ra muḥgashegs su gsol/ 'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi rnam pa can nam/ ma 'grub na pad+ma 'dab brgyad zhig bri/ der bum pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas bsang sbyang*/ bum pa spyi dang mthun par bskyed/ bum pa'i nang du lha bskyed pa ni/ bdag bskyed kyi 'don pa spos pas 'grub cing*/ mthar mchod bstod gtor ma phul ba/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis mchod yon phul bas zhu bar mos/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la sogs gsol gdab lan gsum/ dngos gzhi dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar du rtsa a wa dhū tī dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhig yod par mos la/

bum pa 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med par gyur pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon par bsgoms shig ces brjod la bum pa spyi bor bzhag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur pa/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag par mos mdzod/ ces brjod de bum chu sbyin/ de nas mngon rtogs kyi dmigs pa tshang bar 'bogs/ dbang bskur gyi skabs bum chu spyi bor gtor/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ spros pa la dga' bas tshe ril tshe chang ster ba'i lugs kyang gda'/ yig rnying na med pas ma byas kyang chog go /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o// 'di yang lo ro ras chung pa'i// gdams pa zab mor kun tu grags// ri bo che ba'i yig tshogs las// rab dga' snying po byung ba yin// tshe dpag med dkar po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// ༈ /grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe rta zung 'brel gyi rgyun khyer shin tu zab pa ni/ tho rangs snga bar langs la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng*// hrīḥlas rang nyid rta mchog dpal// nyi ma'i 'od mtshungs nyon mongs sreg /phyag g.yas thod dbyug nam mkhar 'phyar// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams// brkyang bskum khro bo'i rgyan chas rdzogs// bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad me phung 'bar// mdun mkhar rma byas btegs pa yi// rin chen mdzes khri pad zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma tshe dpag med// dmar po mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin// longs spyod rdzogs tshul rdor skyil bzhugs// gnyis ka'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las// 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa// spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabyer med thim// dbang lhas dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag /snang mtha' sprul skus dbur brgyan gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ bcom ldan tshe dpag med mgon dang*// dbang chen dpa' bo rta mgrin la// gus pas bstod do bar chad sol// tshe dbang mchog gi dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sa ra he ka ra re shwa ra re hūm̐/ zhes pas gsol btab thugs srog las// 'od 'phros bdag gi bla tshe srog /chad nyams yar 'thor rgud pa dang*// phyi snod 'byung ba'i bcud dwang ma// nang bcud 'gro ba'i tshe bsod dpal// mchog tu 'phags pa'i ye shes tshe// 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug /bum par zhugs nas zhu zhing khol// bdag gi tshangs pa'i sgo nas zhugs// lus gang tshe yi bar chad zhi// 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub gyur// oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā/ brgya rtsa las mi nyung bar bzlas mthar/ slar yang rang nyid rta mgrin gyi// thugs nas 'od zer rab tu 'bar// tshe bdud 'byung po tshar bcad nas// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku ru gyur// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci rigs bzla/ mthar ni bla ma tshe dpag med// 'od zhu rang thim gnyis med ngang*// bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba kun// 'chi med tshe dpal rgyas par shog /ces pa'ang mi dbang mchog gi nyams bzhes su chos rje gling pa su kha badz+ra gyis phul ba'o// ༈ /'od dpag med kyi tshe sgrub bzhugs so// skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du tshe dpag tu med pa'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhāḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi gnas khang nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su gyur ba'i mdun du/ rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/

skad cig gis rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng du 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ dbu gtsug tor dang bcas shing tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing 'od zer gyis brgyan pa na bza' chos gos ngur smrig dang bcas shing*/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i mtha' skor du bla ma brgyud pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor zhing mngon sum du bzhugs pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a pa ri mi ta ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs kyis bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pas bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gi mthil gyi lhung bzed las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ lha dang mi'i bram ze dang drang srong tshe'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ phyag gi mthil gyi lhung bzed kyi nang gi bdud rtsi la thim pas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du bsam/ de nas rang gi sna bug gnyis nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad mer gyis khengs par bsam pa lan bdun nam gsum bya/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la shes pa gtad la/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā/ lnga brgya bzlas mthar sngar bzhin gsol ba btab nas/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa'am/ mi dmigs par bsam pa gang rung byas nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog
/ces sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam bya/ dge legs bsam 'grub la gnang ba'o/

*/dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos tshe dpag med sprul sku'i rgyun gyi nyams len ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa ste/ tshul 'di la brten nas grub chen bud+dha shrī sku tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa sogs byin rlabs mchog tu che bar grags so// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'od dpag med la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so// bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bo'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung mdzad pa/ na bza' chos gos bsnams pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs nas bla ma la thim pas bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur/ ces brjod cing bsgoms nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde ba dang ldan/ myur du sangs rgyas thob par bla ma mkhyen snyam pa'i mos gus rtse gcig tu byas la/ spro na/ ji snyed su dag bzang spyod las 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa ci nus dang*/ gang ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla ma 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// bdag dang sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde ba dang ldan/ myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba snying gi dkyil rus pa'i gting nas gdab bo// spro na/

tad+ya thā/ oṃ a mi te/ a mi tota bha be/ a mi ta saṃ bha be/ a mi ta bi krān+ta gā mi ni/ ga ga na kīrti ka ri/ sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ zhes snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa'i gzungs kyang ci nus bzla/ rjes la/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur par bsgoms nas de'i ngang la ci nus su bzhag la/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi// zhes sogs bzang spyod smon lam tshang ba'am/ de las gsungs pa'i/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der// pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes// snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du// lung bstan pa yang bdag gzhan der thob shog /der ni bdag gzhan lung bstan rab thob nas// sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis// blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang*// sems can rnams la phan pa mang bgyid shog /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*// chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar bsngos bzhin smon lam 'grub par shog /ces sogs kyis dge ba bsngo'o// bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di bya bral ba dpal 'byor bzang pos zhus pa'i don du/ btsun pa thogs med kyis dngul chu'i chos rdzong du bkod pa'o// slar yang ngag 'don bklags chog tu mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge/ ༈ /snang ba mtha' yas kyi nyal bsgom shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi dgongs pa/ grub chen dze tā ri'i man ngag snang ba mtha' yas kyi nyal bsgom nyams su len par 'dod na/ skyabs sems ji ltar rigs pa dang*// sa phyogs thams cad bde can zhing*// bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus// rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// mdun du pad+ma zla ba'i steng*// snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar// mnyam gzhag bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// de mthar rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor// mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par gyur// ces gsal la yid kyis phyag gsum btsal la bzang spyod las 'byung ba sogs yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs tshar gsum bya/

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// bdag sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skyes nas myur du byang chub tu lung bstan pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag pa'i nges shes bskyed/ lus longs spyod nye du sogs la chags zhen btang*/ shi nas bde ba can du 'gro ba'i 'dun pa dang spro ba shugs drag tu bskyed la 'chi bas mi 'jigs pa'i gdengs bskyed/ de nas/ dbugs phyir rgyu dang lhan cig tu// rang sems rgyal ba'i thugs kar thim// nang du 'jug pa'i dus kyi tshe// rgyal ba'i thugs nas rang gi sems// 'od kyi rnam pas snying gar thim// rgyal ba'i thugs dang rang gi sems// dbyer med ro gcig ngang du bzhag /ces brjod pa'am don bsams la dmigs pa gsal nges pa lan gsum sogs bya/ mdun gyi tshogs zhing 'od du zhu// snang ba mtha' yas nyid la thim// de yang rang thim bdag nyid kyang*// 'od zhu spros bral dbyings su thim// zhes brjod cing*/ sangs rgyas yi dam rang sems gsum dbyer med du 'dres pa'i ngang la bzhag slar yang rang nyid skad cig gis// snang ba mtha' yas sku ru gyur// zhes dang*/ rgyas par bzang spyod smon lam tshang ba'am/ mi nus na/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing sogs smon lam btab nas bde ba can gyi zhing khams yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral ba'i ngang nas gnyid log par bya'o// de ltar ma chags par bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ de la nad dang gdon mi 'byung*/ 'chi ba'i dus na sdug bsngal med/ bar dor thub pas rjes su 'dzin/ phyi ma'i dus na thar pa thob/ ces gsungs so// zhes pa'ang mañdzu gho ṣas so// ༈ /ngan song sbyong ba'i sgom bzlas shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas te/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du snang ba'i steng du/ oṃ sarba bid sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa zhu bas rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gyen du bzhengs par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das kun rig sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi ka dkar ba/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng na rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs par bsgom/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ ces bsgom zhing brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa dbang lha dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs ye shes pa rang dang 'dra ba spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ye shes pa rang la bstim/ rigs lngas dbang bskur bas sgrib pa thams cad dag ste rnam snang gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+yā shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ chos dbyings ye shes skyon bral ba// rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das// ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal bcom ldan kun rig la'o// zhes pas bstod/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sa bon gyi mthar/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas dmigs yul gyis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag par gyur/

ces bsam zhing bzlas la rjes/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rnam snang chen po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces bsngo ba bya'o// sgrib sbyong spyi dang*/ bye brag tu gshin po'i sgrib sbyong la bsngags so// ngan song sbyong ba'i mngon rtogs shin tu bsdus pa la spro ba'i don du/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa thogs med kyis dngul chu'i chos rdzong du sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal snying por dril ba sgrib gnyis mun sel ces bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i// zhabs kyi pad+mor phyag byas nas// gang de'i sgrub thabs sgrib gnyis kyi// mun sel zla ba'i snang ba sbyin// de la skyabs sems dang tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas chos thams cad spros bral du shes pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te tshogs gnyis kyi rang 'bras mtshan bcas lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom zhing bzlas pa bya ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*// a las zla steng rang sems hūm̐ mthing las// rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs// tshur 'dus bdag nyid rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa// dbang sngon mdog can dwangs gsal 'od zer 'phro// phyag g.yas sa gnon g.yon pas mnyam bzhag steng*// rdo rje legs 'dzin zhi 'dzum mtshan dpes mdzes// lha rdzas na bza' rin chen rgyan gyis spras// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing gas// rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs// ces brjod cing bsams la/ lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i srin lag bsnol/ mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar ba'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya gnas gsum du reg cing*/

gzungs sngags tshar re brjod pas byin brlab/ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang thim 'od zhu bas// snying dbus pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng*// hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥlas rigs mchog lnga// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar dar dang rin chen brgyan// 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro bzhin bzhugs par gyur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ bcom ldan rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod cing gsol 'debs na/ bdag gzhan sdig sgrib byang zhing dag pa dang*// mchog thun dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs// snying ga'i gtso bo'i thugs kar zla dkyil steng*// dkar gsal gzungs sngags phreng ba'i snang ba yis// 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro kun sdig sgrib sbyangs// tshur 'dus byin rlabs gzi byin mchog tu 'bar// ces gsal btab la gzung sngags ji tsam nus pa bzla/ thun mthar mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ kun rdzob rang snang lha yi skur// med bzhin snang ba sgyu ma'i gzugs// don dam rang bzhin las 'das pa'i// spros pa bral ba'i ye shes so// zhes pa'i don la so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi dpyad de mnyam par bzhag de las ldang ba na/ rang gi snying dbus ye shes pa// mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la// ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam sprul pa'i// mchod pa'i sprin phung rgya mtshos mchod// gong bzhin mchod cing bstod la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ nongs pa gang mchis mthol bshags shing*// ye shes pa rnams chos dbyings gshegs// rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' yi// gnas gsum 'bru gsum yi ges mtshan// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs bsngo smon bya zhing thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug bsnyen pa byed na thun gsum gyi rim pas gzungs ring 'bum phrag bzhi'am/

gcig bzla/ thun gnyis kyi mthar gtor ma cha gsum yang btang ngo*// bcom ldan rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i// mtshan bcas mtshan med rnal 'byor gyi// snang bas sgrib pa'i mun sel ba// thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gyur cig /ces grub pa'i slob dpon dzai tā ris legs par bkral ba'i rjes su 'brangs te nyung gsal snying por dril ba'i tshul gyi shākya'i dge slong mañdzu gho ṣas sbyar ba'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// thub pa'i dbang po rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs// ye shes snying po ye shes zhi ba'i zhabs// sangs rgyas zhi ba sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*// ku sā li pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ku sā li pa chung ba gser gling pa// dī paṃ kā ra go mi sgom chen dang*// dz+nyā na shrī gnyags ston grags pa'i mtshan// chos kyi rgyal mtshan rnams la= /rin chen 'od zer blo chen sangs rgyas sras// ye shes mgon po seng ge rgyal mtshan dang*// shes rab rdo rje lo chen ma ṇi shrī// sa bzang 'phags pa rnams la= /ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang mus pa rje// rgyal tshab dam pa yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// sa skya lo tsā dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs// shes rab rgyal mtshan rnams la= /nam mkha' dpal bzang rat+nā r+tha sid+dha// shes rab 'byung gnas ye shes bzang po dpal// sangs rgyas phun tshogs bsod nams dpal ldan dang*// nam mkha' bsam 'grub rnams la= kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// rigs kun khyab bdag kun dga' bstan 'dzin sogs// dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog rnams la// mi phyed snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs// nges 'byung byang chub sems kyis rgyud sbyangs te// tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa'i// mtshan bcas mtshan med ting 'dzin mthar phyin nas// thams cad gzigs pa'i ye shes myur thob shog

/ces pa'ang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa'o// ༈ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rgya gcig pa'i sgrub thabs snying po nges gsal bzhugs so// bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag dpal rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rgya gcig pa'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs sems sogs sngon 'gro rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ swa bhā ba sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las dag pa'i snod bcud dbus// pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje sems// dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi zhing 'dzum// phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar gtod// g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten 'gying bas bzhugs// ral pa'i zur phud yid bzhin nor bu dang*// sna tshogs rdo rje zla ba phyed pas mtshan// dar dang rin chen rgyan sogs rdor skyil gyis// 'ja' zer 'od phung 'khyil pa'i dbus na rol// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis// ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim// slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs nas// dbang bskur sgrib dag mi bskyod dbu brgyan gyur// thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng dkar// g.yas su 'khor las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod// sems can sgrib sbyangs rdor sems go 'phang bkod// tshur 'dus sgrib dag byin gyis brlabs par gyur// rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla/ grangs bsnyen las rung gi tshad ni 'bum phrag gcig go /thun bsdu ba na/ bcom ldan khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' yis// bdag dang 'gro kun sdig ltung bag chags zhi// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib gnyis yongs su byang*// myur du rnam mkhyen thob par mdzad du gsol// snang cha'i lha sku 'od gsal dbyings su thim// slar yang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku ru gyur// dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun// sdig sgrib bag chags bcas pa yongs sbyangs te// sku dang ye shes dbyer med bcom ldan 'das// rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang myur thob shog

/ces gsol 'debs bsdu ldang bsngo smon rnams bya'o// zhes pa 'di 'brug pa'i 'phral dgos kyi chos bzhi'i rdor sems rgyal po dzaḥ'i lugs kyi sgom bzlas rgyun khyer du rje bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis mdzad pa zhig go /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /srog slu bya tshul tshe dpal rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// grub pa'i slob dpon chen po ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i zhal nas/ bya nya ri dwags rkun ma dang*// sbrul sogs gsad bya'i phyogs gyur rnams// srog bskyabs pa yis 'phral du ni// tshe thung ba yang tshe ring 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas mtshon gsod par nges pa'i sems can gyi srog bslu ba ni tshe sgrub thams cad kyi mchog tu mdo rgyud bstan bcos mtha' yas pa nas gsungs shing rig pas kyang grub pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis srog bslu la brtson pa ches cher bskyed par bya'o// de la spyir sems bskyed bzang po dang ldan pas bdag tu bzung ba'i dud 'gro gtso bor gyur pa rnams kyi srog bslu zhing*/ rang gi bsad pa dang*/ gzhan la 'tshong ba sogs mi bya bar rang rang gi spyod yul du bde bar 'tsho ba dang*/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab pa tsam bgyis pas skabs kyi don 'grub phyir cho ga dmigs bsal ma byas kyang rung mod/ yul dus kyi spros pa dang bstun nas cung zad rgyas par spro na/ snga 'gyur gyi man ngag 'ga' zhig las srung ba'i rten du 'dzugs pa sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya ba'am/ thun mong du shis brjod bsngo smon tsam spros te bya bar 'dod na/ cho 'phrul zla ba dang*/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i tshes brgyad nya stong sogs dus kyi 'gyur ba khyad par can 'byung ba dang stabs 'grigs na bzang zhing*/

tshe ring ba'i don du gtso bor byed na bsgrub bya'i srog gza' dar ba dang 'phrod sbyor bzang po 'dzoms pa'i nyi shar la bya/ gang ltar yang srog bslu bya rgyu rnams mdun du 'khod pa na/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// sogs skyabs sems lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ spro na sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang*/ gzungs sngags khyad par can mang du brjod na dud 'gro rnams kyi rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon thebs pa sogs phan yon che/ de tsam mi nus kyang*/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das sogs so so'i mgor sbyar bas/ mgon po mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen gtsug tor can la phyag 'tshal lo// bde bar gshegs pa bdun la phyag 'tshal lo// shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ yi ge drug pa/ mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs sogs skad gsang mtho bas brjod/ de nas lag tu me tog thogs la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub pa sogs skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i zhal nas shis pa brjod pa'i dbyangs snyan sgrogs shing me tog gi char chen po phab pas bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gyur pa rnams kyang gnas skabs dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las thar zhing dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og tu bde bar 'tsho ba dang*/ mthar thug thar pa'i sa bon rgyud la smin nas myur du byang chub thob pa'i skal ba can tu gyur par bsams la/

rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs dang*/ ston pa bla med sogs dang*/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs bkra shis gang shes kyi mthar/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags sogs dang*/ tshe gzungs ci nus bzla zhing me tog 'thor/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas mtshon dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams zhabs pad brtan cing phrin las rgyas pa dang*/ rang dang sbyin bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes 'phel ba dang*/ dud 'gro rnams kyang 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las grol nas byang chub rin po che myur du thob par shog cig snyam du 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// sogs dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ gang du skyes pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du// dkon mchog gsum dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing*// dkon mchog gsum po rgyun du mchod pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs 'jug par shog /byang chub sems ni sogs/ phan bde'i 'byung ba'i sogs/ 'jig rten bde zhing sogs/ gzhan yang skye ba 'di nyid du sogs/ bsod nams stobs chen 'di yi mthus// sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// tshe 'dir bsam pa'i don 'grub cing*// bar chad zhi nas bkra shis par// bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon gang shes dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gang yang rung ba'i mthar/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa// de kun lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin// snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin du khyab// tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun grub pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog

/gnas 'dir nyin mo sogs dang*/ ye dharmā brjod la me tog 'thor bas bde legs su bya/ spro na tshe sgrub kyi gzhung gzhan las/ ci 'byor srog bslu bgyis pa'i dpral ba ru// nyi zla'i rtags gdab de phyin srog mi gcod// ces 'byung ba ltar tshe thar bgyis pa rnams kyi dpral bar mar gyis nyi zla'i gzugs 'dri ba tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa'i rten 'brel du bshad la/ nor phyugs dkar mtshan can lta bu'i khyu phud 'ga' re la ming bkra legs pa btags pa'ang bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel du bshad pas de ltar bya'o// gzhan yang bya dang ri dwags dang nya sogs kyi srog skyabs pa'i slad du ri rgya klung rgya bsdam pa na/ gong du bshad pa ltar sems bskyed dang bsngo smon gyi rtsis zin pa dang*/ lha bsang sogs dang 'brel bar byas pas spyir 'chi ba bslu bas mtshon phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ khyad par du yul phyogs der char chu 'bebs shing lo phyugs legs pa sogs bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma 'byung ba dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rin chen phreng ba las/ grog sbur tshang gi sgo dag tu// zan dang chu dang 'bru mar dang*// 'bru yi phung po rtag par ni// thugs brtan mi rnams bgyid du gsol// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar srog chags grog ma la zas sbyin pa dang*/ nya la zan gtsang ma sbyin pa dang*/ nad pa la sman dang*/ byis pa la ston mo dang*/ 'dab chags dang dbul phongs la zas skom sbyin pa sogs kyang byang chub kyi sems dang*/ bsngo smon dag pa'i thabs kyis zin na 'chi ba bslu ba dang*/ 'byor pa spel ba dang*/ mthar thug byang chub chen po'i rgyur 'gyur ba sogs bya sla tshegs chung phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin pas blo ldan rnams kyis sgo du ma nas tshogs gsog pa'i thabs mkhas la brtson par bya'o// zhes pa'ang rang gzhan rnams la phan pa'i don du byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la gus pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te bris pa 'dis kyang bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs pad bskal brgyar brten cing*/

sems can thams cad dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las thar nas mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
